19:39: Guyyaa Gaabbii san isaan sodaachisi, yeroo dhimmichi murtaa’u Haala isaan daguu keessatti ta’aniin isaanii hin amanin.
19:40: Nuti Numatu dachiifi waan ishee irra jiru dhaala; garuma keenya deebifamus.
19:41: Kitaaba (Qur'aana) keessatti Ibraahiim dubbadhu, inni nama akkaan dhugaa dubbataa, nabiyyii ture.
19:42: (dubbadhu) Yeroo inni abbaa isaatiin (aazariin) jedhe “Yaa abbaa kiyya! Maaliif waan (taabota) hin dhageenye, hin argineefi homaa sirraa deebisuu hin dandeenye gabbarta?”.
19:43: “Yaa abbaa koo! Dhugumatti, ani beekumsa irraa wanti sitti hin dhufin (karaa wahyiitiin) natti dhufee jira. na hordofi; ani karaa sirraawaan si qajeelcha.
19:44: Yaa abbaa koo! Sheyxaana hin gabbarin; sheyxaanni Rahmaanitti fincilaa ta’eera.
19:45: Yaa abbaa koo! ani Rahmaan irraa azaabni si tuquun sodaadha, ati sheyxaanaaf jaalallee ta’uu keen (sodaadha)”.
19:46: (Abbaan isaa) nijedhe “Yaa Ibraahiim! Ati gabbaramtoota kiyya (jibbitee) irraa garagaltaa? Yoo hin dhorgamne, ani dhagaaniin si tuma (si cafaqa), Yeroo dheeraaf naan oodi (narraa fagaadhu)”.
19:47: (Ibraahiim) nijedhe “Nageenyi sirra haa jiraatu! Ani Rabbii kiyyan araarama siif kadha, Inni akkaan rahmata naaf godhaa ta’eera”.
19:48: “Isiniifi wantoota isin Rabbiin gaditti gabbartan irraan fagaadha. Rabbii kiyya qofan kadhadha, kadhaa gooftaa kiyyaatiin hoonga’aa ta’uu dhabuu koon abdadha”.
19:49: Yeroma inni isaaniifi waan isaan Rabbii gaditti gabbaran irraa fagaatu, Is'haaqiifi Ya’iquubiin isaaf kennine, Hunda isaanii nabiyyii taasifne.
19:50: Rahmata keenya irraas isaaniif kennine, Gaariin dubbatamuu (faaruu) ol fuudhamaas isaaniif goone.
19:51: Kitaaba (Qur’aana) keessatti (waa’ee) Muusaa dubbadhu, inni filatamaa ta’ee jira; ergamaa, nabiyyii ta’eera.
